cant_reach_server_help: Profiles saved on this device still show, but signing in needs the server.
session_ended_for: {{name}}'s session ended. Sign in again to keep watching.
quick_connect_tile: Quick Connect, sign in with a code
quick_connect_lead: Sign in with a code instead of a password.
quick_connect_step_open_profile: On a phone, computer or TV that's signed in to Jellyfin, open your profile.
quick_connect_approve_help: Sign in on another device with the code it shows.
quick_connect_approve_lead: On the other device, choose Quick Connect. Type the code it shows here to sign it in as {{name}}.
quick_connect_approved_for: Approved. The other device is signing in as {{name}}.
quick_connect_waiting: Waiting for approval · code expires in {{minutes}}:{{seconds}}
no_servers_found_help: No servers found on your network. A server on another network or behind a VPN needs its address.
welcome_lead: Connect to your Jellyfin server to start watching.
welcome_address_help: Use the address you open Jellyfin with in a browser, like 192.168.1.20:8096 or jellyfin.example.com.
addresses_help: VibeyFin tries the address that worked last first, then the others in order.
addresses_swipe_help: Swipe an address to remove it.
remove_server_message_one: 1 profile is signed out on this device and its downloads are deleted. Nothing changes on the server.
remove_server_message_other: {{count}} profiles are signed out on this device and their downloads are deleted. Nothing changes on the server.
remove_server_help_one: Signs out its profile on this device and deletes its downloads. Nothing changes on the server.
remove_server_help_other: Signs out its {{count}} profiles on this device and deletes their downloads. Nothing changes on the server.
server_address_help: Without http:// or a port, VibeyFin tries https, then http, on the usual ports.
already_saved_new_address: You already have this server. This adds the new address to it.
already_saved_existing_address: You already have this server at this address.
people_search_hint: Search for an actor or a director
people_prompt: Type a name to find someone.
nothing_matches_filters: Nothing matches these filters. Try taking one off, or tap Clear.
load_more_failed: Couldn't load the rest of this list. Check your connection and try again.
transcode_reason_video_bit_depth_not_sup: The video's bit depth isn't supported
transcode_reason_audio_channels_not_supp: The audio has too many channels
transcode_reason_container_bitrate_excee: The bitrate is above the limit
search_prompt_help: Type a title, a show or a name.
no_search_results_help: Check the spelling, or try fewer words.
no_episodes: There are no episodes in this season yet.
no_seasons: This show has no seasons yet.
always_ask_who_is_watching_help: Show the profile screen every time the app opens instead of going straight to the last profile.
playback_stats_help: Show codec, bitrate and how the server is delivering the video in the player. Applies to this profile.
auto_skip_segments_help: Jump past marked intros and recaps without asking.
buffer_ahead_help: How much video the player loads ahead of where you are. A longer buffer rides out a slow connection but uses more data and memory. Auto leaves it to the device's player.
skip_help: These set the player's buttons and the double-tap on the left and right of the picture.
home_genre_rows_help: How many genres get a row on Home, the biggest first.
show_watched_in_rows_help: Whether Recently added, genre rows and More like this show titles you've already watched. With it on, Recently added still follows your Jellyfin setting.
still_watching_help: Pause and ask after several episodes in a row so the next one doesn't play to an empty room. Applies to this profile.
switch_profile_help: Asks for the PIN first if one is set.
profile_server_footer: Read only. Add or remove servers from “Who’s watching?”.
sign_out_footer: Asks to confirm. Your tile stays in “Who’s watching?” and asks for the password next time. Not shown on a kids profile.
sign_out_confirm_message: The downloads of this profile are deleted from this device. Your tile stays in “Who’s watching?” and asks for the password next time.
quality_maximum_help: Original quality, direct play when possible.
quality_footer: The cap for everything this profile plays. Lower uses less data; the server may transcode to fit.
skipping_footer: Back: 5, 10, 15 or 30 s. Forward: 10, 15, 30, 45 or 60 s. These are the intervals the player's button glyphs come in, so the button and the setting agree.
auto_skip_help: Off by default. The Skip buttons show either way.
still_watching_after_help: Off, or after 2 to 5 episodes in a row.
picture_in_picture_help: On by default. The player offers picture in picture and starts it when you leave the app. Off, playback pauses when you leave.
swipe_gestures_help: Swipe up or down on the right of the player to change the volume, on the left to change the brightness. The brightness goes back to normal when the player closes.
audio_language_footer: Plays the track in this language when the video has one, otherwise the video’s default track.
remember_tracks_title: Remember what I pick in the player
remember_tracks_help: The next episode starts with the tracks you chose.
languages_footer: Saved to your Jellyfin account, so your other Jellyfin apps use them too. A track you pick in the player still wins for that video.
any_language_subtitle_help: Subtitles in whatever language the video has first.
language_list_footer: The languages your Jellyfin server knows, by the names it uses on tracks.
no_subtitles_hint: Try another language. If no language finds any, the server may need a subtitle provider plugin, such as OpenSubtitles. An admin can add one in the Jellyfin dashboard.
subtitle_mode_footer_default: Default: subtitles the video marks as default or forced.
subtitle_mode_footer_always: Always: whenever there are subtitles in your language.
subtitle_mode_footer_only_forced: Only forced: just the lines for foreign dialogue.
subtitle_mode_footer_smart: Smart: only when the audio isn’t in your language.
subtitle_mode_footer_none: Off: never, unless you turn them on in the player.
captions_follow_system_footer: Turn off to set your own below.
subtitle_style_ios_note: Applies to text subtitles only; iOS burns subtitles in for now
subtitle_preview_sample: This is how subtitles will look.
kids_profile_help: Hides Advanced settings and signing out. The server's own limits still apply.
pin_footer: A household lock, not security. It keeps the next person on the sofa out of Settings and other profiles.
server_policy_footer: Read only. An admin changes these in Jellyfin; the server enforces them.
server_policy_failed: Couldn’t read the limits from your Jellyfin server.
server_policy_none: No limits are set on your Jellyfin server
pin_prompt_wrong: That PIN is wrong. Try again.
pin_prompt_mismatch: The PINs don't match. Try again.
pin_prompt_open_profile: Enter this profile's PIN to open it.
pin_prompt_open_settings: Enter your PIN to open Settings.
pin_prompt_switch_profile: Enter your PIN to switch profile.
pin_prompt_change_pin: Enter your current PIN to change it.
pin_prompt_remove_pin: Enter your PIN to remove it.
pin_prompt_kids_off: Enter your PIN to turn off kids mode.
pin_prompt_attempts_left_one: That PIN is wrong. 1 try left before a short wait.
pin_prompt_attempts_left_other: That PIN is wrong. {{count}} tries left before a short wait.
pin_prompt_locked_one: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in 1 second.
pin_prompt_locked_other: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
pin_forgot_message: Enter {{name}}'s Jellyfin password to remove the PIN. Kids mode stays as it is; the password is not saved.
notifications_toggle: Notify me about new episodes and movies
notifications_followed: Shows I follow and new movies
notifications_blocked: Notifications are blocked for VibeyFin. Allow them in system settings, then switch this on again.
download_notifications_footer: Tells you when downloads finish or fail. VibeyFin asks for permission the first time a download starts; if you declined, allow notifications in system settings.
notifications_footer: Jellyfin sends no push, so the app checks in the background: expect a delay. Switching this on asks for notification permission.
added_titles_channel_description: New episodes of the shows you follow and new movies, for each profile with notifications on
downloads_empty_help: Download a movie or an episode to watch it without a connection.
offline_toast: You're offline. Showing what you've downloaded.
offline_mode_toast: Offline mode is on. Showing what you've downloaded.
offline_by_choice_help: Offline mode is on. Showing what you've downloaded.
server_unreachable_banner_help: You can still watch what you've downloaded.
offline_mode_help: Use only your downloads, even when you're online.
offline_search_empty: Nothing you've downloaded matches. Try another word.
download_over_mobile_help: Off: downloads wait for Wi-Fi. Applies to this profile.
auto_clean_watched_help: Free the space when you finish a download. Applies to this profile.
storage_limit_help: New downloads wait when the limit is reached. Applies to this profile.
purge_downloads_help: Removes every download of this profile and any leftover files, also those shown in the Files app.
purge_downloads_confirm_message: The downloads of this profile are deleted from this device. Other profiles keep theirs. You can download again at any time.
remove_confirm_body_with_size: This frees {{size}}. You can download it again later.
remove_confirm_body: You can download it again later.
seerr_row_help: Find and request titles that aren’t in your library.
seerr_lead: Connect Seerr to find and request titles that aren’t in your library yet.
seerr_address_help: Set up once for this server. Every profile signs in by itself, with no password.
seerr_address_shared_help: Other profiles on this server use this address. Changing it changes it for them too.
seerr_disconnect_help: Signs this profile out of Seerr and hides it here. Other profiles on this server keep it. Your requests stay in Seerr.
seerr_disconnect_confirm_message: This profile is signed out of Seerr and stops seeing it. Other profiles on this server keep it.
seerr_password_reason: Quick Connect is off on your Jellyfin server, so Seerr needs your Jellyfin password once.
seerr_status_line_requested_by_me: Requested by you · Waiting for approval
seerr_status_line_approved: Approved · Added when the download finishes
seerr_status_line_partly_available: Some seasons are in your library
seerr_status_line_failed: The download failed · Seerr will try again
seerr_menu_status_detail_partly_availabl: Some seasons are in your library
seerr_no_requests: You haven’t requested anything yet. Search for a title that isn’t in your library to request it.
seerr_title_description_not_requested: {{title}}, {{meta}}, not in your library, can be requested
load_forbidden: This account isn't allowed to see that. Ask the server's admin for access.
load_not_found: That isn't on the server any more. It may have been removed or moved.
load_unexpected: The server sent something VibeyFin couldn't read. Try again, and update the server if it keeps happening.
load_no_compatible_stream: The server can't play this on your device. Ask the server's admin to check the file's format.
load_playback_failed: This video wouldn't play. Try again, or ask the server's admin to check the file.
load_add_to_my_list_failed: Couldn't add this to My List. Check your connection and try again.
load_remove_from_my_list_failed: Couldn't remove this from My List. Check your connection and try again.
load_mark_watched_failed: Couldn't mark this as watched. Check your connection and try again.
load_mark_unwatched_failed: Couldn't mark this as unwatched. Check your connection and try again.
load_remove_from_continue_failed: Couldn't remove this from Continue watching. Check your connection and try again.
load_restore_to_continue_failed: Couldn't put this back in Continue watching. Check your connection and try again.
load_download_forbidden: This account isn't allowed to download. Ask the server's admin to turn downloads on for it.
load_download_no_space: There isn't enough space on this device. Remove a download or free some space, then try again.
load_download_storage_limit: This would go over your storage limit for downloads. Remove a download or raise the limit in Settings.
load_download_interrupted: The download failed. Remove it and try again.
load_download_sign_in: Sign in again to go on with this download.
load_download_not_on_server: This is no longer on the server, so it can't be downloaded.
load_download_unplayable: This video is in a format this device can't play, so it can't be downloaded here.
load_download_no_file: This has no file to download.
load_not_downloaded: This isn't downloaded, so it can't open without a connection.
load_languages_unreachable: Can’t reach your server, so these can’t change right now. They’re saved on your Jellyfin account; try again when you’re back online.
load_languages_save_failed: Couldn’t save that to your Jellyfin account. Check your connection and try again.
load_subtitles_not_allowed_text: Ask an admin to turn on “Allow subtitle management” for your account.
load_subtitles_unreachable_text: Check your connection and try again.
load_subtitles_add_failed: Couldn’t add these subtitles. Check your connection and try again.
load_subtitles_did_not_arrive_has_one: These subtitles didn’t arrive. This title already has a subtitle file in this language, so the server may have kept it as it was. Otherwise the provider’s daily limit may be reached.
load_subtitles_did_not_arrive: These subtitles didn’t arrive. The provider’s daily limit may be reached. Try again tomorrow, or choose a result from another provider.
load_playback_network: Lost the connection to the server. Check your network and try again.
load_for_error_server: The server answered with an error (HTTP {{status}}). Try again in a minute.
sign_in_wrong_password: That password didn't work. Check it and try again.
sign_in_wrong_credentials: That username or password didn't work. Check them and try again.
sign_in_session_ended: Your session ended. Sign in again.
sign_in_unreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check that it's on and that this device can reach its network.
sign_in_quick_connect_expired: That code expired before it was approved. Get a new one and try again.
sign_in_quick_connect_off: This server doesn't allow Quick Connect. Sign in with a password instead, or ask the server's admin to turn Quick Connect on.
sign_in_quick_connect_failed: Quick Connect didn't work. Try again.
sign_in_quick_connect_code_unknown: This server didn't give out that code. Check it on the other device, or get a new one there.
sign_in_quick_connect_approve_off: Quick Connect is off on this server. The server's admin can turn it on in the Jellyfin dashboard.
sign_in_quick_connect_approve_failed: Couldn't approve that code. Try again.
sign_in_for_failure_server: The server answered with an error (HTTP {{status}}). Try again in a minute.
sign_in_for_failure_other: Something went wrong signing in. Try again.
seerr_message_invalid_address: Enter Seerr’s address, such as requests.example.org.
seerr_message_unreachable_address: Can’t reach Seerr at this address. Check it and try again.
seerr_message_not_seerr: This isn’t a Seerr address. Check it and try again.
seerr_message_wrong_server: This Seerr is linked to a different Jellyfin server.
seerr_message_no_access: Seerr didn’t let this Jellyfin user in. Ask whoever runs Seerr to allow it.
seerr_message_failed: Seerr couldn’t sign you in. Try again.
seerr_message_quick_connect_off: Quick Connect is off on your Jellyfin server.
seerr_message_wrong_password: That password didn’t work. Try again.
seerr_message_password_unreachable: Can’t reach Seerr. Check your connection and try again.
seerr_message_not_allowed: Your Seerr account can’t request this. Ask whoever runs Seerr.
seerr_message_request_unreachable: Can’t reach Seerr. Check your connection, then try again.
seerr_message_request_failed: Seerr couldn’t take the request. Try again.
seerr_message_cancel_failed: Couldn’t cancel the request. Try again.
seerr_message_signed_out: You’re not signed in to Seerr. Open Settings › Seerr to sign in again.
seerr_message_forbidden: Your Seerr account isn’t allowed to see that. Ask whoever runs Seerr.
seerr_message_unexpected: Seerr sent something VibeyFin couldn’t read. Try again, and update Seerr if it keeps happening.
seerr_message_for_error_server: Seerr answered with an error (HTTP {{status}}). Try again in a minute.
seerr_message_quota_reached_try_later: Your request limit is reached. Try again later.
seerr_message_quota_reached_movies: Your request limit is reached. You can request {{movies}}.
seerr_message_quota_reached_movies_a_day: Your request limit is reached. You can request {{movies}} a day.
seerr_message_quota_reached_movies_a_wee: Your request limit is reached. You can request {{movies}} a week.
seerr_message_quota_reached_movies_every: Your request limit is reached. You can request {{movies}} every {{count}} day.
Your request limit is reached. You can request {{movies}} every {{count}} days.
seerr_message_quota_reached_seasons: Your request limit is reached. You can request {{seasons}}.
seerr_message_quota_reached_seasons_a_da: Your request limit is reached. You can request {{seasons}} a day.
seerr_message_quota_reached_seasons_a_we: Your request limit is reached. You can request {{seasons}} a week.
seerr_message_quota_reached_seasons_ever: Your request limit is reached. You can request {{seasons}} every {{count}} day.
Your request limit is reached. You can request {{seasons}} every {{count}} days.
seerr_message_too_many_seasons_one: You can request 1 more season for now. Pick fewer seasons.
seerr_message_too_many_seasons_other: You can request {{count}} more seasons for now. Pick fewer seasons.
delete_subtitles_help: Subtitles built into the video can’t be deleted, so they aren’t listed.
delete_subtitle_text: They’re deleted from the server for everyone and can’t be brought back.
load_subtitle_delete_failed: Couldn’t delete these subtitles. Check your connection and try again.
load_subtitle_delete_not_allowed: Your account can’t delete subtitles. Ask the server’s admin to do it.
load_subtitle_already_gone: These subtitles were already deleted from the server.
connection_issue_invalid_address: That doesn't look like a server address. Try an IP address like 192.168.1.20:8096, or a web address like https://jellyfin.example.com.
connection_issue_unreachable: Couldn't reach a server at that address. Check the address and port, make sure the server is on, and that this device can reach its network.
connection_issue_tls_failed: The secure connection failed, which usually means a self-signed or expired certificate. If the server is on your home network, try http:// with port 8096. Otherwise, fix the server's certificate.
connection_issue_server_unavailable: The server answered with an error (HTTP {{status}}). It may still be starting up, or the proxy in front of it can't reach Jellyfin. Try again in a minute.
connection_issue_not_jellyfin: Something answered at that address, but it isn't a Jellyfin server (HTTP {{status}}). Check the port: Jellyfin usually listens on 8096.
connection_issue_version_too_old: This server runs Jellyfin {{found}}. VibeyFin needs {{minimum}} or newer. Update the server, then try again.
language_help: Changes the language of VibeyFin. System screens such as permission prompts and the share sheet keep your device language.
